name: 簡報
author: 林亞澤
description: 全螢幕 16:9 簡報卡。內容用 Markdown 型標記寫，一行 --- 分頁，有封面、條列、表格、雙欄、程式碼、宣言五種頁型與深淺兩種底；←→ 翻頁、N 備註抽屜、P 講者主控台（縮圖跳頁、講稿、節奏計時），講稿也能開在第二個視窗或手機上（掃 QR 或複製網址），附雷射筆；頁內可嵌外站。三組配色可再覆寫主色。最後一頁出「結束」鈕接下一張卡。
descriptionEn: Fullscreen 16:9 slide deck card. Write slides in a Markdown-like markup separated by ---, with cover, bullet, table, two-column, code and statement layouts in dark or light. Arrow keys to navigate, N for notes, P for the presenter console (thumbnails, script, pacing timer), phone remote with laser pointer via QR, live site embeds. Three colour presets with overrides. An end button on the last slide advances to the next card.

fields.defaultValue:
[cover pace=2]
## 主題類別 · 副標籤
# 主標題文字 **焦點關鍵字**
一句話交代這場的核心價值：你將帶走什麼，以及為什麼這件事現在重要。
> 開場先問一輪：誰已經做過這件事。第一句講清楚今天的範圍。
---
[pace=6]
## 一 · 重點
# 核心重點**一覽**
- **第一點**：清晰的需求與背景脈絡 _補充說明_
- **第二點**：執行的關鍵步驟與常見陷阱
- **第三點**：成果驗收與自動化交付
這一行是頁尾的小字備註。
> 三點各講一分鐘，第二點停久一點。
---
[light dense pace=9]
## 二 · 規則
# 主題解謎，**9/20 截止**
| 項目 | 內容 |
| --- | --- |
| 交件 | 9/6 到 9/20 23:59 |
| 評審 | 9/21 到 9/27，9/28 公布 |
|! 報名 | 創好帳號報名，完成投稿再得獎勵 |
規則細節在活動頁。這一頁是動力用的。
---
[light cols pace=12]
## 三 · 架構
# 架構原則：**兩種視角**
### 給人看的
清晰的文案與指引，讓參與者一目了然。
```
console.log("Hello Developer!");
```
|||
### 給機器看的
標準的結構化資料與錯誤處理協議。
```
{ "status": "ok", "next_action": "proceed" }
```
---
[pace=14]
# 頁內嵌一個站：**右側視窗**
- 一行 `@embed 網址` 就把站嵌在右邊，跟著簡報一起走。
- 加 `full` 變成標題下方的全寬視窗，加 `lazy` 變成按了才載入。
- 對方站不能設 X-Frame-Options，而且要禁得起沒有儲存空間的環境。
@embed https://yazelin.github.io/glitch-music/
> 示範的時候直接按播放。
---
[statement pace=15]
## 總結一句話
# 把**規格**與**驗收標準**做成每個人都能上手的工具。
今晚的簡報、講義與範例原始碼全部公開。
> 收尾。投票頁停久一點。

<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>簡報</title>
<!--
  Larch 簡報插件卡（slide-deck）。整份簡報用 Markdown 型標記寫在卡片的「內容」欄位，
  這支把它畫成 slide-deck skill 的 16:9 簡報：←→ 翻頁、N 備註抽屜、P 主控台（縮圖跳頁、
  講稿、節奏計時）、R 計時歸零、手機遙控（走 deck-sync worker 的 WebSocket）、雷射筆畫布、
  頁內嵌外站、圖片燈箱。最後一頁出「結束」鈕送 larch:complete，插件卡會自己接下一張。

  標記規格見 README.md。manifest.py 會把 deck.css 與 qrcode.min.js 塞進兩個 /*@…*/ 記號。
-->
<style>
/* slide-deck-skill: Universal 16:9 responsive presentation styling
   Supports Dark / Light / Statement themes, multi-column, tables, code blocks,
   interactive live embeds, image lightboxes, and synchronized presenter mode.
   Optimized for cross-platform rendering (Windows, macOS, Linux). */

/* 換色只改下面這 17 個變數，其他規則一行都不用動。
   刻意不吃變數的例外只有五種，換色時它們不該跟著變：
   陰影與遮罩的黑、圖片與縮圖的底 #000、iframe 與 QR 的白底
   （QR 白底變色會掃不到）、假瀏覽器視窗列 .winbar 的中性灰。
   衍生色用 color-mix()，需要 2023 年之後的瀏覽器。 */
:root {
  --ink: #12100c;
  --surface: #1e1a12;
  --surface-2: #262115;
  --surface-3: #2f2818;
  --border: #38301f;
  --mist: #8c846f;
  --cream: #f3efe6;
  --muted: #b6ad98;
  --amber: #f4b53a;
  --amber-deep: #d98a1e;
  --amber-soft: #ffd98a;
  --cyan: #22d3ee;
  --day-bg: #f4faf7;
  --day-ink: #274741;
  --day-accent: #177f92;
  --day-dim: #5b6f68;
  --warn: #fb923c;
}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { height: 100%; }
body {
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang TC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--cream);
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
::selection { background: var(--amber); color: var(--ink); }

/* Top status bar */
.bar {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 10;
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  padding: 1rem 2.2rem; font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .3em; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mist) 95%, transparent);
}
.bar a { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 80%, transparent); text-decoration: none; }
.bar .mark { color: var(--amber); }

/* Slide base */
.slide {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none;
  flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
  padding: 8vh 9vw;
  background:
    radial-gradient(110% 80% at 50% -12%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 12%, transparent), transparent 58%),
    radial-gradient(80% 60% at 92% 8%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 7%, transparent), transparent 55%),
    var(--ink);
}
.slide.active { display: flex; animation: slidein .45s both; }
@keyframes slidein { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

/* Typography */
.kicker { font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .42em; color: var(--amber); margin-bottom: 1.6rem; text-transform: uppercase; }
h1 {
  font-family: "Noto Serif TC", "Songti TC", "PMingLiU", "Times New Roman", serif; font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4.6rem); line-height: 1.25;
}
h1 em, h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--amber); }
h2 {
  font-family: "Noto Serif TC", "Songti TC", "PMingLiU", serif; font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem); line-height: 1.35; margin-bottom: 2.2rem;
}
.sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.25rem); line-height: 2; max-width: 34em; margin-top: 1.4rem; }

/* Bullet points */
ul.points { list-style: none; max-width: 56rem; }
ul.points li {
  font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); line-height: 1.8; color: var(--cream);
  padding: .85rem 0 .85rem 2.2rem; position: relative;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mist) 16%, transparent);
}
ul.points li::before { content: "—"; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--amber); }
ul.points li strong { color: var(--amber); font-weight: 700; }
ul.points li .dim { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85em; }

/* Statement slide */
.slide.statement { align-items: flex-start; }
.statement p.big {
  font-family: "Noto Serif TC", "Songti TC", "PMingLiU", serif; font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 4.6vw, 3.4rem); line-height: 1.6; max-width: 22em;
}
.statement p.big em { font-style: normal; color: var(--amber); }

/* Code & Preformatted */
pre {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 75%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mist) 28%, transparent);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 1.5rem 1.7rem; max-width: 62rem; max-height: 60vh; overflow: auto;
  font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", "Consolas", "Menlo", monospace;
  font-size: clamp(.76rem, 1.3vw, 1rem); line-height: 1.75; color: var(--amber-soft);
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}
.code-note { margin-top: 1.1rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.8; max-width: 56rem; }

/* Tables */
table { border-collapse: collapse; max-width: 60rem; font-size: clamp(.88rem, 1.55vw, 1.12rem); }
th, td { padding: .75rem 1.2rem; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mist) 20%, transparent); line-height: 1.7; }
th { color: var(--amber); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; font-size: .85em; }
td { color: var(--cream); } td .dim { color: var(--muted); }
table.dense { font-size: clamp(.76rem, 1.22vw, .95rem); }
table.dense td { padding: .4rem .6rem; line-height: 1.55; }
table.dense td:first-child { white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 700; }
tr.grp td {
  padding-top: 1.1rem; font-size: .86em; letter-spacing: .14em; color: var(--amber);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 35%, transparent); white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 700;
}
.slide.light tr.grp td { color: var(--day-accent); border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--day-accent) 35%, transparent); }

/* Multi-column grid */
.cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3.2rem; max-width: 66rem; }
.cols.three { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 2.4rem; }
.cols h3 { font-family: "Noto Serif TC", "Songti TC", serif; color: var(--amber); font-size: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: .9rem; }
.cols p, .cols li { color: var(--cream); line-height: 1.85; font-size: 1.02rem; }
.cols ul { list-style: none; }
.cols li { padding-left: 1.4rem; position: relative; margin-bottom: .45rem; }
.cols li::before { content: "—"; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--amber); }

/* Big Stat blocks */
.stats { display: flex; gap: 3.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 1rem 0 1.6rem; }
.stat b {
  display: block; font-family: "Noto Serif TC", serif; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.4rem);
  color: var(--amber); line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: .4rem;
}
.stat span { font-size: .95rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .05em; }

/* Light Theme variant */
.slide.light {
  background:
    radial-gradient(90% 70% at 50% -10%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--day-accent) 12%, transparent), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(70% 50% at 85% 90%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 8%, transparent), transparent 55%),
    var(--day-bg);
  color: var(--day-ink);
}
.slide.light h1, .slide.light h2 { color: var(--day-ink); }
.slide.light h1 em, .slide.light h2 em { color: var(--day-accent); }
.slide.light .kicker { color: var(--day-accent); }
.slide.light .sub { color: var(--day-dim); }
.slide.light ul.points li { color: var(--day-ink); border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--day-dim) 20%, transparent); }
.slide.light ul.points li::before { color: var(--day-accent); }
.slide.light ul.points li strong { color: var(--day-accent); }
.slide.light ul.points li .dim { color: var(--day-dim); }
.slide.light pre {
  background: #ffffff; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--day-accent) 30%, transparent);
  border-left-color: var(--day-accent); color: var(--day-ink);
}
.slide.light .code-note { color: var(--day-dim); }
.slide.light table th { color: var(--day-accent); }
.slide.light table td { color: var(--day-ink); border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--day-dim) 20%, transparent); }
.slide.light table td .dim { color: var(--day-dim); }
.slide.light .cols h3 { color: var(--day-accent); }
.slide.light .cols p, .slide.light .cols li { color: var(--day-ink); }
.slide.light .cols li::before { color: var(--day-accent); }

/* Inline tags and URLs */
.url { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--amber-soft); word-break: break-all; }
.slide.light .url { color: var(--day-accent); }

/* Screenshots & Lightbox */
img.shot {
  max-width: 48%; max-height: 52vh; border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mist) 30%, transparent); cursor: zoom-in;
  transition: transform .2s, border-color .2s; object-fit: contain; background: #000;
}
img.shot:hover { transform: scale(1.02); border-color: var(--amber); }
.lightbox {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .88);
  display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2rem; cursor: zoom-out;
}
.lightbox.open { display: flex; }
.lightbox img { max-width: 94vw; max-height: 94vh; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }

/* Live Embed / Video Container */
.livewrap {
  position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 62rem; height: 50vh;
  margin: 1rem 0; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mist) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--surface);
  /* 沒滿版的時候當成一個小視窗:標題列可以拖,右下角可以拉大小。
     resize 要有作用,overflow 就不能是 visible(上面已經是 hidden)。 */
  resize: both;
}
.livewrap.maxi { resize: none; }

/* 視窗標題列。只有它是拖曳把手,拖在內容上會被 iframe 吃掉。 */
.winbar {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 30px; z-index: 25;
  background: #17171a; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(110, 110, 114, .35);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 11px;
  cursor: grab; user-select: none;
}
.winbar:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.winbar i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; }
.winbar span { margin-left: 8px; margin-right: 11rem; font-size: .72rem; color: #8d8d92;
  font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
/* 還原鈕放左邊。右邊留給 fsbtn,有些頁有兩顆(載入 + 備援影片),放右邊會被蓋住。 */
.winbar .home {
  margin-left: 4px; background: none; border: 1px solid rgba(110,110,114,.4); cursor: pointer;
  color: #8d8d92; font-size: .7rem; padding: .15rem .5rem; border-radius: 4px; flex: none;
}
.winbar .home:hover { color: var(--cream); background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); }

/* 標題列佔掉 30px,內容往下挪 */
.livewrap > .livebox, .livewrap > .poster { margin-top: 30px; height: calc(100% - 30px); }
.livebox { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; display: block; background: #fff; }

/* 內嵌位置的預覽圖:還沒按按鈕時就看得到等一下會出現什麼,匯出的 PDF 那幾頁也不會是空白框 */
.livewrap > .poster {
  position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background-size: cover; background-position: top center;
  filter: grayscale(.2) brightness(.58);
}
.livewrap > .poster::after {
  content: attr(data-hint);
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 1.1rem; text-align: center;
  color: var(--amber); font-size: .85rem; letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .95);
}
.fsbtn {
  position: absolute; top: .32rem; right: .5rem; z-index: 30;
  background: var(--ink); color: var(--amber); border: 1px solid var(--amber);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
  border-radius: 4px; padding: .3rem .7rem; font-size: .8rem; cursor: pointer;
}
.fsbtn:hover { background: var(--amber); color: var(--ink); }
/* 兩欄版面裡的內嵌框要矮一點。用 :not(.maxi) 圈住,
   不然滿版時這個高度會壓過下面的 96vh。 */
.livewrap.short:not(.maxi) { height: 38vh; }

.livewrap.maxi {
  position: fixed; inset: 2vh 2vw; width: 96vw; height: 96vh; max-width: none;
  z-index: 90; box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Presenter Mode (Press 'P' or append ?present=1)
   ========================================================================== */
#presenter { display: none; }
body.present { overflow: auto; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 62%, black); }
body.present .slide { display: none !important; }
body.present .bar { display: none !important; }
body.present #presenter {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50% 1fr; height: 100vh;
  color: var(--cream); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}
#pjump {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 85%, var(--surface)); border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 62%, var(--ink));
  overflow-y: auto; padding: .6rem;
  /* 兩欄:整欄 16:9 縮圖一次只看得到四五張,三十頁的簡報找頁要一直捲。 */
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: .4rem; align-content: start;
}
.pj {
  padding: .5rem; border-radius: 8px; font-size: .82rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 62%, var(--mist));
  cursor: pointer; display: block; border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.pj img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9; object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 5px; background: #000; margin-bottom: .35rem; pointer-events: none; }
.pj:hover { background: var(--surface); color: var(--cream); }
.pj.on { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--amber); border-color: var(--amber); font-weight: 700; }

.pmain { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 2rem 3rem; overflow-y: auto; gap: 1.2rem; }
.phead { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 62%, var(--ink)); padding-bottom: .8rem; }
.pnum { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--mist); }
.ptimer { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--cream); }
.ptitle { font-family: "Noto Serif TC", serif; font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--amber); font-weight: 700; }
.pnote {
  font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.9; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cream) 82%, var(--muted)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 65%, var(--ink));
  border-left: 4px solid var(--amber); padding: 1.4rem 1.8rem; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
  flex: 1; overflow-y: auto;
}
.pnote b { color: var(--amber); }
.pnext { font-size: .95rem; color: var(--mist); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 62%, var(--ink)); padding-top: .8rem; }
.pnext b { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cream) 55%, var(--muted)); }

/* 開播前檢查:主控台常駐,翻到哪一頁都看得到,免得忘了啟動要 demo 的服務 */
.pflight {
  margin: .6rem 0 .4rem; padding: .55rem .8rem; border-radius: 6px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 8%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 28%, transparent);
  font-size: .78rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--amber-soft);
}
.pflight b { color: var(--amber); letter-spacing: .06em; }
.pflight code {
  background: rgba(14, 14, 16, .75); padding: .05rem .35rem; border-radius: 3px;
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; color: var(--cream);
}

/* 常見問答:跟開播前檢查一樣常駐,現場被問到不用臨時想 */
.pfaq {
  margin: .4rem 0; padding: .5rem .8rem; border-radius: 6px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 7%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 25%, transparent);
  font-size: .74rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--muted);
}
.pfaq > b { display: block; color: var(--cyan); letter-spacing: .06em; margin-bottom: .2rem; }
.pfaq span { display: block; }
.pfaq span b { color: var(--cream); }
.pfaq code {
  background: rgba(14, 14, 16, .75); padding: .05rem .3rem; border-radius: 3px;
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; color: var(--amber-soft);
}
.pfoot { font-size: .75rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mist) 65%, var(--border)); text-align: center; }

/* In-slide Notes overlay (Press 'N') */
#notes { display: none; }
body.show-notes #notes {
  display: block; position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; max-height: 42vh;
  overflow-y: auto; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 97%, transparent); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cream) 82%, var(--muted)); z-index: 30;
  padding: 1rem 2rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--amber); font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.85;
}
#notes > div { display: none; }
#notes > div.on { display: block; }
#notes b { color: var(--amber); }

/* Remote Controller Button & Modal */
.premote-btn {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 15%, transparent); color: var(--amber); border: 1px solid var(--amber);
  border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; margin-left: 1rem;
}
.premote-btn:hover { background: var(--amber); color: var(--ink); }

.remote-modal {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100000; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88);
  display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2rem;
}
.remote-modal.open { display: flex !important; }
.remote-dialog {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, var(--ink)); border: 2px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 2.4rem; max-width: 30rem; width: 100%; text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.2rem;
  z-index: 100001;
}
.remote-dialog h3 { font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--amber); font-weight: 700; }
.remote-dialog p { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--cream); line-height: 1.6; }
.remote-qr { width: 280px; height: 280px; margin: 0.6rem auto; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; padding: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
.remote-qr svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.remote-pin { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--amber-soft); background: var(--surface-2); padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
.remote-close {

}
.remote-close:hover { background: var(--amber); color: var(--ink); }

  position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
  pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; display: block;
}

img.shot { max-width: 100%; max-height: 58vh; border-radius: 8px; cursor: zoom-in; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mist) 30%, transparent); }

var qrcode = function() {

  // qrcode
  //---------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * qrcode
   * @param typeNumber 1 to 40
   * @param errorCorrectionLevel 'L','M','Q','H'
   */
  var qrcode = function(typeNumber, errorCorrectionLevel) {

    var PAD0 = 0xEC;
    var PAD1 = 0x11;

    var _typeNumber = typeNumber;
    var _errorCorrectionLevel = QRErrorCorrectionLevel[errorCorrectionLevel];
    var _modules = null;
    var _moduleCount = 0;
    var _dataCache = null;
    var _dataList = [];

    var _this = {};

    var makeImpl = function(test, maskPattern) {

      _moduleCount = _typeNumber * 4 + 17;

        var modules = new Array(moduleCount);

          modules[row] = new Array(moduleCount);
          for (var col = 0; col < moduleCount; col += 1) {

          }
        }

      }(_moduleCount);

      setupPositionProbePattern(0, 0);
      setupPositionProbePattern(_moduleCount - 7, 0);
      setupPositionProbePattern(0, _moduleCount - 7);
      setupPositionAdjustPattern();
      setupTimingPattern();
      setupTypeInfo(test, maskPattern);

      if (_typeNumber >= 7) {
        setupTypeNumber(test);
      }

      if (_dataCache == null) {
        _dataCache = createData(_typeNumber, _errorCorrectionLevel, _dataList);
      }

      mapData(_dataCache, maskPattern);
    };

    var setupPositionProbePattern = function(row, col) {

      for (var r = -1; r <= 7; r += 1) {

        if (row + r <= -1 || _moduleCount <= row + r) continue;

        for (var c = -1; c <= 7; c += 1) {

          if (col + c <= -1 || _moduleCount <= col + c) continue;

          if ( (0 <= r && r <= 6 && (c == 0 || c == 6) )
              || (0 <= c && c <= 6 && (r == 0 || r == 6) )
              || (2 <= r && r <= 4 && 2 <= c && c <= 4) ) {
            _modules[row + r][col + c] = true;
          } else {
            _modules[row + r][col + c] = false;
          }
        }
      }
    };

    var getBestMaskPattern = function() {

      var minLostPoint = 0;
      var pattern = 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {

        makeImpl(true, i);

        var lostPoint = QRUtil.getLostPoint(_this);

        if (i == 0 || minLostPoint > lostPoint) {
          minLostPoint = lostPoint;
          pattern = i;
        }
      }

      return pattern;
    };

    var setupTimingPattern = function() {

      for (var r = 8; r < _moduleCount - 8; r += 1) {
        if (_modules[r][6] != null) {
          continue;
        }
        _modules[r][6] = (r % 2 == 0);
      }

      for (var c = 8; c < _moduleCount - 8; c += 1) {
        if (_modules[6][c] != null) {
          continue;
        }
        _modules[6][c] = (c % 2 == 0);
      }
    };

    var setupPositionAdjustPattern = function() {

      var pos = QRUtil.getPatternPosition(_typeNumber);

      for (var i = 0; i < pos.length; i += 1) {

        for (var j = 0; j < pos.length; j += 1) {

          var row = pos[i];
          var col = pos[j];

          if (_modules[row][col] != null) {
            continue;
          }

          for (var r = -2; r <= 2; r += 1) {

            for (var c = -2; c <= 2; c += 1) {

              if (r == -2 || r == 2 || c == -2 || c == 2
                  || (r == 0 && c == 0) ) {
                _modules[row + r][col + c] = true;
              } else {
                _modules[row + r][col + c] = false;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };

    var setupTypeNumber = function(test) {

      var bits = QRUtil.getBCHTypeNumber(_typeNumber);

      for (var i = 0; i < 18; i += 1) {
        var mod = (!test && ( (bits >> i) & 1) == 1);
        _modules[Math.floor(i / 3)][i % 3 + _moduleCount - 8 - 3] = mod;
      }

      for (var i = 0; i < 18; i += 1) {
        var mod = (!test && ( (bits >> i) & 1) == 1);
        _modules[i % 3 + _moduleCount - 8 - 3][Math.floor(i / 3)] = mod;
      }
    };

    var setupTypeInfo = function(test, maskPattern) {

      var data = (_errorCorrectionLevel << 3) | maskPattern;
      var bits = QRUtil.getBCHTypeInfo(data);

      // vertical
      for (var i = 0; i < 15; i += 1) {

        var mod = (!test && ( (bits >> i) & 1) == 1);

        if (i < 6) {
          _modules[i][8] = mod;
        } else if (i < 8) {
          _modules[i + 1][8] = mod;
        } else {
          _modules[_moduleCount - 15 + i][8] = mod;
        }
      }

      // horizontal
      for (var i = 0; i < 15; i += 1) {

        var mod = (!test && ( (bits >> i) & 1) == 1);

        if (i < 8) {
          _modules[8][_moduleCount - i - 1] = mod;
        } else if (i < 9) {
          _modules[8][15 - i - 1 + 1] = mod;
        } else {
          _modules[8][15 - i - 1] = mod;
        }
      }

      // fixed module
      _modules[_moduleCount - 8][8] = (!test);
    };

    var mapData = function(data, maskPattern) {

      var inc = -1;
      var row = _moduleCount - 1;
      var bitIndex = 7;
      var byteIndex = 0;
      var maskFunc = QRUtil.getMaskFunction(maskPattern);

      for (var col = _moduleCount - 1; col > 0; col -= 2) {

        if (col == 6) col -= 1;

        while (true) {

          for (var c = 0; c < 2; c += 1) {

            if (_modules[row][col - c] == null) {

              var dark = false;

              if (byteIndex < data.length) {
                dark = ( ( (data[byteIndex] >>> bitIndex) & 1) == 1);
              }

              var mask = maskFunc(row, col - c);

              if (mask) {
                dark = !dark;
              }

              _modules[row][col - c] = dark;
              bitIndex -= 1;

              if (bitIndex == -1) {
                byteIndex += 1;
                bitIndex = 7;
              }
            }
          }

          row += inc;

          if (row < 0 || _moduleCount <= row) {
            row -= inc;
            inc = -inc;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

    var createBytes = function(buffer, rsBlocks) {

      var offset = 0;

      var maxDcCount = 0;
      var maxEcCount = 0;

      var dcdata = new Array(rsBlocks.length);
      var ecdata = new Array(rsBlocks.length);

      for (var r = 0; r < rsBlocks.length; r += 1) {

        maxEcCount = Math.max(maxEcCount, ecCount);

        }
        offset += dcCount;

        var rsPoly = QRUtil.getErrorCorrectPolynomial(ecCount);
        var rawPoly = qrPolynomial(dcdata[r], rsPoly.getLength() - 1);

        var modPoly = rawPoly.mod(rsPoly);
        ecdata[r] = new Array(rsPoly.getLength() - 1);
        for (var i = 0; i < ecdata[r].length; i += 1) {
          var modIndex = i + modPoly.getLength() - ecdata[r].length;
          ecdata[r][i] = (modIndex >= 0)? modPoly.getAt(modIndex) : 0;
        }
      }

      var totalCodeCount = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < rsBlocks.length; i += 1) {
        totalCodeCount += rsBlocks[i].totalCount;
      }

      var data = new Array(totalCodeCount);
      var index = 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < maxDcCount; i += 1) {
        for (var r = 0; r < rsBlocks.length; r += 1) {

            data[index] = dcdata[r][i];
            index += 1;
          }
        }
      }

      for (var i = 0; i < maxEcCount; i += 1) {
        for (var r = 0; r < rsBlocks.length; r += 1) {
          if (i < ecdata[r].length) {
            data[index] = ecdata[r][i];
            index += 1;
          }
        }
      }

      return data;

    var createData = function(typeNumber, errorCorrectionLevel, dataList) {

      var rsBlocks = QRRSBlock.getRSBlocks(typeNumber, errorCorrectionLevel);

      var buffer = qrBitBuffer();

      for (var i = 0; i < dataList.length; i += 1) {
        var data = dataList[i];
        buffer.put(data.getMode(), 4);
        buffer.put(data.getLength(), QRUtil.getLengthInBits(data.getMode(), typeNumber) );
        data.write(buffer);

      // calc num max data.
      var totalDataCount = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < rsBlocks.length; i += 1) {
        totalDataCount += rsBlocks[i].dataCount;
      }

      if (buffer.getLengthInBits() > totalDataCount * 8) {

          + buffer.getLengthInBits()
          + '>'
          + totalDataCount * 8
          + ')';
      }

      // end code
      if (buffer.getLengthInBits() + 4 <= totalDataCount * 8) {
        buffer.put(0, 4);
      }

      // padding
      while (buffer.getLengthInBits() % 8 != 0) {
        buffer.putBit(false);
      }

      // padding
      while (true) {

        if (buffer.getLengthInBits() >= totalDataCount * 8) {
          break;
        }
        buffer.put(PAD0, 8);

        if (buffer.getLengthInBits() >= totalDataCount * 8) {
          break;
        }
        buffer.put(PAD1, 8);
      }

      return createBytes(buffer, rsBlocks);
    };

    _this.addData = function(data, mode) {

      mode = mode || 'Byte';

      var newData = null;

      switch(mode) {
      case 'Numeric' :
        newData = qrNumber(data);
        break;
      case 'Alphanumeric' :
        newData = qrAlphaNum(data);

      case 'Byte' :
        newData = qr8BitByte(data);
        break;
      case 'Kanji' :
        newData = qrKanji(data);
        break;
      default :
        throw 'mode:' + mode;
      }

      _dataList.push(newData);
      _dataCache = null;
    };

    _this.isDark = function(row, col) {
      if (row < 0 || _moduleCount <= row || col < 0 || _moduleCount <= col) {
        throw row + ',' + col;
      }
      return _modules[row][col];
    };

    _this.getModuleCount = function() {
      return _moduleCount;

    _this.make = function() {
      if (_typeNumber < 1) {
        var typeNumber = 1;

        for (; typeNumber < 40; typeNumber++) {
          var rsBlocks = QRRSBlock.getRSBlocks(typeNumber, _errorCorrectionLevel);
          var buffer = qrBitBuffer();

          for (var i = 0; i < _dataList.length; i++) {
            var data = _dataList[i];
            buffer.put(data.getMode(), 4);
            buffer.put(data.getLength(), QRUtil.getLengthInBits(data.getMode(), typeNumber) );

          var totalDataCount = 0;
          for (var i = 0; i < rsBlocks.length; i++) {

          if (buffer.getLengthInBits() <= totalDataCount * 8) {
            break;
          }

      makeImpl(false, getBestMaskPattern() );

      qrHtml += '">';
      qrHtml += '<tbody>';

      for (var r = 0; r < _this.getModuleCount(); r += 1) {

        qrHtml += '<tr>';

        for (var c = 0; c < _this.getModuleCount(); c += 1) {
          qrHtml += '<td style="';
          qrHtml += ' border-width: 0px; border-style: none;';
          qrHtml += ' border-collapse: collapse;';
          qrHtml += ' padding: 0px; margin: 0px;';
          qrHtml += ' width: ' + cellSize + 'px;';
          qrHtml += ' height: ' + cellSize + 'px;';
          qrHtml += ' background-color: ';

/* ---- 標記 → DOM ---- */
function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>'); }
function inline(s, boldTag){
  s = esc(s);
  s = s.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:[^)\s]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');
  s = s.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
  s = s.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<'+boldTag+'>$1</'+boldTag+'>');
  s = s.replace(/(^|[^\w])_([^_\n]+?)_(?!\w)/g, '$1<span class="dim">$2</span>');
  return s;
}
function parseDeck(md){
  var slides = [], cur = null;
  md.replace(/\r\n?/g,'\n').split('\n').forEach(function(line){
    if (/^---\s*$/.test(line)) { cur = null; return; }
    if (!cur) { cur = {tags:{}, lines:[], notes:[]}; slides.push(cur); }
    var m = line.match(/^\[([^\]]+)\]\s*$/);
    if (m && !cur.lines.length) { m[1].split(/\s+/).forEach(function(t){ var kv=t.split('='); cur.tags[kv[0]]=kv.length>1?kv[1]:true; }); return; }
    if (/^>\s?/.test(line)) { cur.notes.push(line.replace(/^>\s?/,'')); return; }
    cur.lines.push(line);
  });
  return slides.filter(function(s){ return s.lines.some(function(l){return l.trim();}) || s.notes.length; });
}
function blocks(lines, ctx){
  // 把一段行序列畫成 HTML。ctx: {para: 'sub'|'note'|'p', title: 'h1'|'h2'|'big'}
  var out = [], i = 0, embeds = [];
  function flushList(items){ if(items.length) out.push('<ul class="points">'+items.map(function(t){return '<li>'+inline(t,'strong')+'</li>';}).join('')+'</ul>'); }
  function flushTable(rows, dense){
    if(!rows.length) return;
    var head = null; if (rows.length>1 && rows[1].sep) { head = rows.shift(); rows.shift(); }
    var h = '<table'+(dense?' class="dense"':'')+'>';
    if (head) h += '<thead><tr>'+head.cells.map(function(c){return '<th>'+inline(c,'strong')+'</th>';}).join('')+'</tr></thead>';
    h += '<tbody>'+rows.filter(function(r){return !r.sep;}).map(function(r){ return '<tr'+(r.grp?' class="grp"':'')+'>'+r.cells.map(function(c){return '<td>'+inline(c,'strong')+'</td>';}).join('')+'</tr>'; }).join('')+'</tbody></table>';
    out.push(h);
  }
  var items = [], rows = [];
  while (i < lines.length) {
    var l = lines[i];
    if (/^- /.test(l)) { flushTable(rows,ctx.dense); rows=[]; items.push(l.slice(2)); i++; continue; }
    if (/^\|/.test(l)) { flushList(items); items=[];
      var body = l.replace(/^\|!?\s?/,'').replace(/\|\s*$/,''); var cells = body.split('|').map(function(c){return c.trim();});
      rows.push({cells:cells, sep: cells.every(function(c){return /^-{2,}$/.test(c);}), grp: /^\|!/.test(l)}); i++; continue; }
    flushList(items); items=[]; flushTable(rows,ctx.dense); rows=[];
    if (/^```/.test(l)) { var code=[]; i++; while(i<lines.length && !/^```/.test(lines[i])) code.push(lines[i++]); i++; out.push('<pre>'+esc(code.join('\n'))+'</pre>'); continue; }
    if (/^### /.test(l)) { out.push('<h3>'+inline(l.slice(4),'em')+'</h3>'); i++; continue; }
    if (/^## /.test(l)) { out.push('<p class="kicker">'+inline(l.slice(3),'em')+'</p>'); i++; continue; }
    if (/^# /.test(l)) { var t=inline(l.slice(2),'em'); out.push(ctx.title==='big'?'<p class="big">'+t+'</p>':'<'+ctx.title+'>'+t+'</'+ctx.title+'>'); i++; continue; }
    if (/^@embed\s+/.test(l)) { var p = l.split(/\s+/), e = {url: p[1], mode: 'right', w: '', h: ''};
      p.slice(2).forEach(function(x){ if (/^(right|full|lazy)$/.test(x)) e.mode = x; else if (!e.w) e.w = x; else if (!e.h) e.h = x; });
      embeds.push(e); i++; continue; }
    if (/^@img\s+/.test(l)) { var q=l.split(/\s+/); out.push('<img class="shot" src="'+esc(q[1])+'" alt="'+esc(q.slice(2).join(' '))+'">'); i++; continue; }
    if (l.trim()) { var cls = ctx.para==='sub'?' class="sub"':ctx.para==='note'?' class="code-note"':''; out.push('<p'+cls+'>'+inline(l,'strong')+'</p>'); }
    i++;
  }
  flushList(items); flushTable(rows,ctx.dense);
  // 標題與 kicker 永遠排最前面（kicker 在標題前），其餘照寫的順序
  var kick = out.filter(function(h){return /^<p class="kicker">/.test(h);}), ttl = out.filter(function(h){return /^<h[12]>|^<p class="big">/.test(h);});
  var rest = out.filter(function(h){return kick.indexOf(h)<0 && ttl.indexOf(h)<0;});
  return {html: kick.concat(ttl, rest).join('\n'), embeds: embeds};
}
var embedSeq = 0;
function embedHtml(e, full){
  var id = 'embed-'+(++embedSeq), host = e.url.replace(/^https?:\/\//,'').replace(/\/$/,'');
  // 寬高可以自己指定：右側框吃 flex-basis（例如 44% 讓對方站進桌機版面），全寬框吃 width
  var st = [];
  if (e.w) st.push(full ? 'width:'+e.w : 'flex:0 0 '+e.w);
  if (e.h) st.push('height:'+e.h);
  var body = e.mode==='lazy'
    ? '<button class="fsbtn" data-load="'+id+'" type="button">載入</button><div id="'+id+'-slot" class="slot" data-src="'+esc(e.url)+'">'+esc(host)+'</div>'
    : '<iframe class="livebox" src="'+esc(e.url)+'" title="'+esc(host)+'" allow="autoplay" loading="eager"></iframe>';
  return '<div class="livewrap'+(full?' full':'')+'" id="'+id+'" data-host="'+esc(host)+'"'
       + (st.length ? ' style="'+st.join(';')+'"' : '') + '>'
       + '<button class="fsbtn alt2" data-max="'+id+'" type="button">滿版</button>' + body + '</div>';
}
function render(md){
  var slides = parseDeck(md), root = document.getElementById('slides'), notesEl = document.getElementById('notes'), pace = [], last = 0;
  root.innerHTML = ''; notesEl.innerHTML = '';
  slides.forEach(function(s, idx){
    var t = s.tags, cls = ['slide']; if (t.light) cls.push('light'); if (t.statement) cls.push('statement');
    // 這一段以 <section 開頭就當成手寫 HTML 原樣放進去（slide-deck skill 的 deck.html 可以整段貼過來）。
    // 標記那一套完全不介入，class 以自己寫的為準，只有 [pace=N] 還會被讀走。
    var raw = s.lines.join('\n').trim();
    if (/^<section\b/i.test(raw)) {
      var box = document.createElement('div'); box.innerHTML = raw;
      var mine = box.querySelector('section');
      if (mine) { mine.classList.add('slide'); mine.classList.remove('active'); root.appendChild(mine); }
      var hn = document.createElement('div');
      hn.innerHTML = s.notes.map(function(x){ return inline(x, 'b'); }).join('<br>');
      notesEl.appendChild(hn);
      if (t.pace) last = parseFloat(t.pace) || last; pace.push(last);
      return;
    }
    var ctx = {title: t.cover?'h1':t.statement?'big':'h2', para: (t.cover||t.statement)?'sub':'note', dense: !!t.dense};
    var html;
    if (t.cols) {
      var cols = [], buf = []; s.lines.forEach(function(l){ if (/^\|\|\|\s*$/.test(l)) { cols.push(buf); buf=[]; } else buf.push(l); }); cols.push(buf);
      var head = blocks(cols[0].filter(function(l){return /^#{1,2} /.test(l);}), ctx);
      var body = cols.map(function(c){ return '<div>'+blocks(c.filter(function(l){return !/^#{1,2} /.test(l);}), {title:'h2',para:'p',dense:ctx.dense}).html+'</div>'; });
      html = head.html + '<div class="cols'+(cols.length>2?' three':'')+'">'+body.join('')+'</div>';
      var em = head.embeds; s._embeds = em;
    } else {
      var b = blocks(s.lines, ctx); html = b.html; s._embeds = b.embeds;
    }
    var right = (s._embeds||[]).filter(function(e){return e.mode==='right'||e.mode==='lazy';});
    var fulls = (s._embeds||[]).filter(function(e){return e.mode==='full';});
    if (fulls.length) {
      // 全寬內嵌放在標題之後
      var parts = html.split('\n'), ti = -1; parts.forEach(function(p,k){ if(/^<h[12]>|^<p class="big">/.test(p)) ti=k; });
      parts.splice(ti+1, 0, fulls.map(function(e){return embedHtml(e,true);}).join(''));
      html = parts.join('\n');
    }
    if (right.length) { cls.push('withpane'); html = '<div class="pane-row"><div class="main">'+html+'</div>'+right.map(function(e){return embedHtml(e,false);}).join('')+'</div>'; }
    var sec = document.createElement('section'); sec.className = cls.join(' '); sec.innerHTML = html; root.appendChild(sec);
    var n = document.createElement('div'); n.innerHTML = s.notes.map(function(x){return inline(x,'b');}).join('<br>'); notesEl.appendChild(n);
    if (t.pace) last = parseFloat(t.pace) || last; pace.push(last);
  });
  return pace;
}

/* ---- 執行期（從 slide-deck skill 的 deck.html 搬來，改成吃 values） ---- */
var values = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS), booted = false;
function applyTheme(v){
  var th = THEMES[v.theme] || THEMES.amber, rs = document.documentElement.style;
  Object.keys(th).forEach(function(k){ rs.setProperty('--'+k, th[k]); });
  var ov = {amber: v.accent, ink: v.ink, cream: v.cream, 'day-bg': v.dayBg, 'day-accent': v.dayAccent};
  Object.keys(ov).forEach(function(k){ var c=String(ov[k]||'').trim(); if (/^#[0-9a-f]{3,8}$/i.test(c)) rs.setProperty('--'+k, c); });
  var fs = parseFloat(v.fontScale); if (fs>0.3 && fs<3) document.documentElement.style.fontSize = (fs*100)+'%';
}
function boot(v){
  if (booted) return; booted = true;
  values = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, v || {});
  applyTheme(values);
  document.getElementById('brand').textContent = values.brand || '';
  document.getElementById('subtitle').textContent = values.subtitle ? ' · ' + values.subtitle : '';
  document.getElementById('pflight').innerHTML = values.flight ? String(values.flight).split('\n').map(function(l){return inline(l,'b');}).join('<br>') : '';
  document.getElementById('pfaq').innerHTML = values.faq ? '<b>常見問答</b>' + String(values.faq).split('\n').filter(function(l){return l.trim();}).map(function(l){ var p=l.split('|'); return '<span><b>'+inline(p[0],'b')+'</b>　'+inline(p.slice(1).join('|'),'b')+'</span>'; }).join('') : '';
  var PACE = render(String(values.content||''));
  document.body.classList.add('ready');
  fitAll(); addEventListener('resize', function(){ clearTimeout(fitAll._t); fitAll._t = setTimeout(fitAll, 150); });
  runtime(PACE);
  grab(); setTimeout(grab, 300);
}
function fitAll(){
  // 每一頁暫時顯示出來量，超出畫面就加一級 fit，最多四級。內嵌視窗載入不影響高度（固定 vh）。
  document.querySelectorAll('.slide').forEach(function(s){
    var was = s.classList.contains('active'); s.classList.remove('fit1','fit2','fit3','fit4');
    s.style.display = 'flex'; s.style.visibility = was ? '' : 'hidden';
    var bar = document.querySelector('.bar').getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 6;
    function crowded(){ if (s.scrollHeight > s.clientHeight + 2) return true; var top = 1e9;   // 也不能頂到上方狀態列
      [].forEach.call(s.children, function(c){ var r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.height > 0) top = Math.min(top, r.top); }); return top < bar; }
    for (var k = 1; k <= 4 && crowded(); k++) { s.classList.remove('fit'+(k-1)); s.classList.add('fit'+k); }
    s.style.display = ''; s.style.visibility = '';
  });
}
function grab(){ try { window.focus(); document.body.focus(); } catch(e){} }
document.body.tabIndex = -1;

function runtime(PACE){
  var SYNC_SERVER = String(values.remoteServer||'').trim().replace(/\/$/,'');
  var slides = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
  var noteBlocks = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#notes > div'));
  var counter = document.getElementById('counter');
  var pnum = document.getElementById('pnum'), ptitle = document.getElementById('ptitle');
  var pnote = document.getElementById('pnote'), pnext = document.getElementById('pnext'), ptimer = document.getElementById('ptimer');
  var pjump = document.getElementById('pjump'), endBtn = document.getElementById('larch-end');
  var cur = 0;
  function paceOf(i){ return PACE[i] || 0; }
  function titleOf(sl){ var el = sl.querySelector('h1, h2, .big'); return el ? el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() : ''; }
  slides.forEach(function(sl, i){
    var d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'pj';
    d.textContent = (i+1) + '. ' + titleOf(sl).slice(0, 14) + (paceOf(i) ? " (" + paceOf(i) + "')" : '');
    d.onclick = function(){ show(i); }; pjump.appendChild(d);
  });
  function render(){
    slides.forEach(function(sl, j){ sl.classList.toggle('active', j === cur); });
    noteBlocks.forEach(function(n, j){ n.classList.toggle('on', j === cur); });
    counter.textContent = (cur+1) + ' / ' + slides.length;
    pnum.textContent = '第 ' + (cur+1) + ' / ' + slides.length + ' 頁' + (paceOf(cur) ? ' · 目標 ' + paceOf(cur) + ' 分' : '');
    ptitle.textContent = titleOf(slides[cur]);
    pnote.innerHTML = noteBlocks[cur] && noteBlocks[cur].innerHTML ? noteBlocks[cur].innerHTML : '（這頁無備註）';
    pnext.innerHTML = (cur+1 < slides.length) ? ('下一頁 → <b>' + titleOf(slides[cur+1]) + '</b>') : '（最後一頁）';
    [].forEach.call(pjump.children, function(d, i){ d.classList.toggle('on', i === cur); });
    var on = pjump.children[cur]; if (on && document.body.classList.contains('present')) on.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
    endBtn.style.display = (values.showEnd && cur === slides.length-1) ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
    broadcastState();
  }
  function show(i){ cur = Math.min(Math.max(i, 0), slides.length-1); strokes = []; render(); }
  endBtn.textContent = values.endLabel || '繼續';
  endBtn.onclick = function(){ parent.postMessage({type:'larch:complete', result:'complete', payload:{}}, '*'); };

  // 手機遙控（WebSocket 到 deck-sync worker；sandbox iframe 打得到，實測過）
  // 房號與密碼留空就隨機（每次開卡都不同）；填了就固定，可以在開播前先把遙控頁開在第二個視窗
  var roomId = String(values.remoteRoom||'').trim() || ('deck-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8));
  var roomPin = String(values.remotePin||'').trim() || String(Math.floor(1000 + Math.random()*9000));
  var syncWs = null;
  function initSyncSocket(){
    if (!SYNC_SERVER) return;
    try {
      syncWs = new WebSocket(SYNC_SERVER.replace(/^http/,'ws') + '/ws?room=' + encodeURIComponent(roomId) + '&role=host&pin=' + encodeURIComponent(roomPin));
      syncWs.onopen = function(){ broadcastState(); };
      syncWs.onmessage = function(e){ try { var msg = JSON.parse(e.data);
        if (msg.type === 'next') show(cur+1); else if (msg.type === 'prev') show(cur-1);
        else if (msg.type === 'jump' && typeof msg.page === 'number') show(msg.page);
        else if (msg.type === 'laser') laserData = msg;
        else if (msg.type === 'draw') {
          if (msg.state === 'start') lastDrawPoint = {x:msg.x, y:msg.y};
          else if (msg.state === 'move' && lastDrawPoint) { strokes.push({x1:lastDrawPoint.x, y1:lastDrawPoint.y, x2:msg.x, y2:msg.y, time:Date.now()}); lastDrawPoint = {x:msg.x, y:msg.y}; }
          else if (msg.state === 'end') lastDrawPoint = null;
        } else if (msg.type === 'draw_clear') strokes = [];
      } catch(err){} };
      syncWs.onclose = function(){ setTimeout(initSyncSocket, 3000); };
    } catch(e){}
  }
  initSyncSocket();
  function broadcastState(){
    if (syncWs && syncWs.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) syncWs.send(JSON.stringify({type:'state', page:cur, total:slides.length, title:titleOf(slides[cur]),
      note: noteBlocks[cur] ? noteBlocks[cur].innerHTML : '', timer: ptimer.textContent, slides: slides.map(function(s){ return {title:titleOf(s)}; })}));
  }

  // 雷射筆與螢光筆畫布
  var pCanvas = document.getElementById('pointer-canvas'), pCtx = pCanvas.getContext('2d');
  var laserData = {active:false, x:0, y:0}, strokes = [], lastDrawPoint = null;
  function resizeCanvas(){ pCanvas.width = innerWidth * (devicePixelRatio||1); pCanvas.height = innerHeight * (devicePixelRatio||1); }
  addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas); resizeCanvas();
  (function renderPointer(){
    var w = pCanvas.width, h = pCanvas.height, dpr = devicePixelRatio||1, now = Date.now(); pCtx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    for (var i = strokes.length-1; i >= 0; i--) { var s = strokes[i], age = now - s.time; if (age > 3500) { strokes.splice(i,1); continue; }
      pCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(244,181,58,' + (Math.max(0, 1-age/3500)*0.75) + ')'; pCtx.lineWidth = 8*dpr; pCtx.lineCap = pCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
      pCtx.beginPath(); pCtx.moveTo(s.x1*w, s.y1*h); pCtx.lineTo(s.x2*w, s.y2*h); pCtx.stroke(); }
    if (laserData.active) { var lx = laserData.x*w, ly = laserData.y*h, g = pCtx.createRadialGradient(lx,ly,2*dpr,lx,ly,18*dpr);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,1)'); g.addColorStop(.2,'rgba(255,60,60,.95)'); g.addColorStop(.6,'rgba(255,40,40,.45)'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,0,0,0)');
      pCtx.fillStyle = g; pCtx.beginPath(); pCtx.arc(lx,ly,18*dpr,0,Math.PI*2); pCtx.fill(); }
    requestAnimationFrame(renderPointer);
  })();

  // 手機遙控 QR
  var remoteModal = document.getElementById('remote-modal'), premoteBtn = document.getElementById('premote-btn');
  if (!SYNC_SERVER) premoteBtn.style.display = 'none';
  premoteBtn.onclick = function(){
    var url = SYNC_SERVER + '/remote?room=' + encodeURIComponent(roomId) + '&pin=' + encodeURIComponent(roomPin);
    var qr = qrcode(0, 'M'); qr.addData(url); qr.make(); document.getElementById('remote-qr').innerHTML = qr.createSvgTag(4, 2);
    document.getElementById('remote-link').value = url;
    document.getElementById('remote-pin').textContent = '房間: ' + roomId + ' · 密碼: ' + roomPin;
    remoteModal.classList.add('open');
  };
  document.getElementById('remote-copy').onclick = function(){
    var i = document.getElementById('remote-link'), btn = this;
    i.focus(); i.select(); i.setSelectionRange(0, i.value.length);
    var ok = false; try { ok = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch(e){}   // opaque origin 沒有 navigator.clipboard
    btn.textContent = ok ? '已複製' : '請手動複製';
    setTimeout(function(){ btn.textContent = '複製'; }, 1800);
  };
  document.getElementById('remote-close').onclick = function(){ remoteModal.classList.remove('open'); };
  remoteModal.onclick = function(e){ if (e.target === remoteModal) remoteModal.classList.remove('open'); };

  // 鍵盤
  addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.target && /INPUT|TEXTAREA/.test(e.target.tagName)) return;
    if (document.body.classList.contains('has-maxi')) {   // 滿版時方向鍵歸裡面那份，Esc 還原
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { var mx = document.querySelector('.livewrap.maxi');
        var mb = mx && document.querySelector('.fsbtn[data-max="'+mx.id+'"]'); if (mb) mb.click(); }
      return; }
    if (['ArrowRight',' ','PageDown'].indexOf(e.key) > -1) { e.preventDefault(); show(cur+1); }
    else if (['ArrowLeft','PageUp'].indexOf(e.key) > -1) { e.preventDefault(); show(cur-1); }
    else if (e.key === 'Home') { e.preventDefault(); show(0); }
    else if (e.key === 'End') { e.preventDefault(); show(slides.length-1); }
    else if (e.key === 'n' || e.key === 'N') document.body.classList.toggle('show-notes');
    else if (e.key === 'p' || e.key === 'P') { document.body.classList.toggle('present');
      if (document.body.classList.contains('present')) { var on = pjump.children[cur]; if (on) on.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); } }
    else if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') t0 = Date.now();
    else if (e.key === 'Escape') { document.querySelectorAll('.livewrap.maxi').forEach(function(w){ w.classList.remove('maxi'); }); document.body.classList.remove('has-maxi'); document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('open'); }
  });
  // 點畫面：右 2/3 下一頁、左 1/3 上一頁（手機沒鍵盤）。互動元素上不翻。
  if (values.clickNav) document.body.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if (document.body.classList.contains('present') || e.target.closest('a,button,iframe,video,.livewrap,#notes,#presenter,.remote-modal,.lightbox,img.shot')) return;
    show(e.clientX < innerWidth/3 ? cur-1 : cur+1);
  });
  var tx = null;
  addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){ tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
  addEventListener('touchend', function(e){ if (tx === null) return; var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 50 && !e.target.closest('video, iframe, #notes, .lightbox, .remote-modal, #presenter')) show(cur + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1)); tx = null; }, {passive:true});

  // 節奏計時器
  var t0 = Date.now();
  function two(n){ return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }
  setInterval(function(){ var sec = Math.floor((Date.now()-t0)/1000);
    ptimer.textContent = two(Math.floor(sec/60)) + ':' + two(sec%60);
    ptimer.style.color = (paceOf(cur) && sec > paceOf(cur)*60) ? '#ff6b6b' : '#fff'; }, 1000);


  // 內嵌框當成小視窗：標題列可拖、右下角可拉大小、還原回原位。整段照 slide-deck skill 的
  // deck.html 搬過來，行為要跟瀏覽器版一致。一碰就浮起來：原位留一個同尺寸的佔位方塊，
  // 框本身改成 fixed 疊在最上層，否則拉大小會把同一頁其他內容推開。
  document.querySelectorAll('.livewrap').forEach(function(w){
    if (w.querySelector('.winbar')) return;
    var bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'winbar';
    bar.innerHTML = '<i style="background:#fb5f57"></i><i style="background:#fdbc2e"></i><i style="background:#28c840"></i>'
      + '<button class="home" type="button" title="還原大小與位置">還原大小</button><span></span>';
    bar.querySelector('span').textContent = w.dataset.host || '';
    w.insertBefore(bar, w.firstChild);

    var spacer = null, prevW = 0, prevH = 0, curW = 0, curH = 0;
    function popOut(pw, ph){
      if (spacer || w.classList.contains('maxi')) return;
      var r = w.getBoundingClientRect(), cs = getComputedStyle(w);
      spacer = document.createElement('div');
      spacer.style.width = (pw || r.width) + 'px'; spacer.style.height = (ph || r.height) + 'px';
      spacer.style.flex = 'none'; spacer.style.margin = cs.margin;
      w.parentNode.insertBefore(spacer, w);
      w.style.position = 'fixed'; w.style.left = r.left+'px'; w.style.top = r.top+'px';
      w.style.width = r.width+'px'; w.style.height = r.height+'px';
      w.style.margin = '0'; w.style.maxWidth = 'none'; w.style.zIndex = 40;
    }
    function putBack(){
      w._noPop = true;
      setTimeout(function(){ w._noPop = false; prevW = prevH = curW = curH = 0; }, 300);
      if (spacer) { spacer.remove(); spacer = null; }
      prevW = prevH = curW = curH = 0;
      ['position','left','top','width','height','margin','maxWidth','zIndex'].forEach(function(k){ w.style[k]=''; });
    }
    var sx=0, sy=0, ox=0, oy=0, dragging=false;
    bar.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
      if (e.target.closest('button') || w.classList.contains('maxi')) return;
      popOut(); dragging = true; sx = e.clientX; sy = e.clientY;
      ox = parseFloat(w.style.left)||0; oy = parseFloat(w.style.top)||0;
      bar.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    });
    bar.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){ if (!dragging) return;
      w.style.left = (ox + e.clientX - sx)+'px'; w.style.top = (oy + e.clientY - sy)+'px'; });
    bar.addEventListener('pointerup', function(e){ dragging = false;
      try { bar.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(err){} });
    bar.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });   // 點視窗列不要翻頁
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
      new ResizeObserver(function(){
        prevW = curW; prevH = curH; curW = w.offsetWidth; curH = w.offsetHeight;
        if (!spacer && prevW && !w._noPop && !w.classList.contains('maxi')) popOut(prevW, prevH);
      }).observe(w);
    }
    bar.querySelector('.home').addEventListener('click', putBack);
    var slide = w.closest('.slide');
    if (slide && typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {
      new MutationObserver(function(){
        if (!slide.classList.contains('active') && spacer && !w.classList.contains('maxi')) putBack();
      }).observe(slide, {attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class']});
    }
    addEventListener('resize', function(){ if (spacer && !w.classList.contains('maxi')) putBack(); });
    w._winSave = function(){ w._noPop = true; putBack(); };
    w._winDone = function(){ setTimeout(function(){ w._noPop = false; prevW = prevH = curW = curH = 0; }, 250); };
  });

  // 滿版與還原
  document.querySelectorAll('.fsbtn[data-max]').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      var w = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.max); if (!w) return;
      var going = !w.classList.contains('maxi');
      if (w._winSave) { w._noPop = true; if (going) w._winSave(); }
      w.classList.toggle('maxi');
      if (w._winDone) w._winDone();
      document.body.classList.toggle('has-maxi', w.classList.contains('maxi'));
      btn.textContent = w.classList.contains('maxi') ? '還原' : '滿版';
    });
  });
  // 延遲載入的內嵌
  document.querySelectorAll('.fsbtn[data-load]').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ var slot = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.load + '-slot'); if (!slot || slot.tagName === 'IFRAME') return;
      var f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.className = 'livebox'; f.id = slot.id; f.src = slot.dataset.src; f.setAttribute('allow','autoplay'); slot.replaceWith(f); btn.textContent = '已載入'; });
  });
  // 圖片燈箱
  var lb = document.getElementById('lightbox'), lbi = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  document.querySelectorAll('img.shot').forEach(function(im){ im.onclick = function(){ lbi.src = im.src; lbi.alt = im.alt; lb.classList.add('open'); }; });
  lb.onclick = function(){ lb.classList.remove('open'); };

  show(0);
}

/* ---- Larch 協定：ready → init（values）；編輯器預覽不會送 init，2 秒後用預設值自己開 ---- */
addEventListener('message', function(e){ var d = e.data; if (!d || d.type !== 'larch:init') return; boot(d.values || {}); grab(); });
parent.postMessage({type:'larch:ready'}, '*');
setTimeout(function(){ boot({}); }, 2000);
</script>
